issue: Output-object serialization mistaken for document mutation
example: Investment Wallet component inspectors in Fable/Kimi/Gemini
decision: Ignore property assignments to locally declared ordinary object literals; keep node-creation and edit operations.

issue: Reference screenshot mistaken for final product verification
example: Investment Wallet early screenshots of source components
decision: Before product construction, unresolved-reference screenshot maps to preparation; screenshot of known final screen maps to verification.

issue: Mixed work unit forced into one stage
decision: Keep P+C+I multi-labels; use one primary label only for reduced timeline visualization.

issue: API schema probe mistaken for user-screen construction
decision: Code environment/API adaptation separately, with an orthogonal probe tag.

issue: Stored helper code mistaken for rendered UI
example: Furniro drawing utilities and component preparation
decision: Use explicit preparation purpose, not merely the presence of createFrame text.

issue: Compaction summary mistaken for final handoff
decision: Use the full selected log when available; require a visible response after the final tool result.
